# Ground texture candidate: Moon Dusted 05

Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/moon_dusted_05
License: CC0 1.0 — https://polyhaven.com/license
Retrieved 14 November 2026 through the public Poly Haven files API. Exact URLs, map resolutions and upstream checksums are retained in files.json. The four downloaded 1K JPEG channels (diffuse, OpenGL normal, roughness, AO) matched the upstream MD5 checksums. Originals are unmodified. The four 1K maps are copied to game/public/assets/surfaces/dust and used only by the present-day hub.

Runtime selection: Moon Flat Macro 02 was too smooth in the gameplay camera. Moon Dusted 05 retains fine grain at a 2.22 m tile scale, with reduced normal strength, continuous coordinate warping and distance/pixel-footprint filtering. Broad terrain colors remain. This is a lunar-themed visual material, not measured Mars data. The old episode materials remain unchanged.
